summary: RW (amendment 2026-11-28 item 1, genuinely learned rewards). Audit: the mix stayed 1 because the promotion test compared single policy steps (power ~0 at realistic rates), existed only at applied meta-updates, and the outer estimator used only the 3-4 decisions between two live updates; defect: level readings were stored as the level. Changed (reward/): prospective anytime-valid validity evidence decides the mix (no margin, no held-out reservation); pooled first-order outer estimator ('auto' default, query-window fallback); outer utility default 'direct'; level readings as changes; ST-3 information value as a bootstrap input. Debug scale, one long LabWorld objective per seed vs a frozen R_psi (same seeds, controlled configuration without goal term): learning raised R_psi's prospective agreement with verified outcomes in 17/18 seed-configurations; the evidence promoted R_psi in 4 of 9 600-decision objectives (frozen: 0 of 12), decisions changed 7-31 decisions later, and in each of the four the chosen actions' true value afterwards exceeded the frozen counterfactual (+2.06 [1.58, 2.54], +2.05 [-0.92, 5.08], +1.01 [0.37, 1.71], +1.71 [0.22, 3.29] adopters per decision; one seed each). Integrated agent (debug, 120 decisions, agent configuration): 9/143 meta-updates applied, 47 pairs, no promotion. Real configuration (Qwen3-4B + 50m, backbone on, one GPU hold): 35 decisions, 4/36 meta-updates applied, 17 pairs, e-value 1.0, mix 1, R_psi weight 0 in all 11 live updates. Not shown: promotion or improvement on the real model; reliable improvement in general.
